depth.name: Shallow
depth.note: Cheaper to dig. Holds less storm water.

depth.name: Deep
depth.note: Holds more water, but the bottom can run low on oxygen in summer.

outlet.name: Small outlet
outlet.note: Water leaves slowly, so it gets cleaned more. Floods sooner and clogs fast.

outlet.name: Large outlet
outlet.note: Drains storms faster and clogs less. Water gets less time to settle.

rainGardens.name: No rain gardens
rainGardens.note: Runoff goes straight to the pond.

rainGardens.name: 2 rain gardens
rainGardens.note: Soak up some runoff before it reaches the pond.

rainGardens.name: 4 rain gardens
rainGardens.note: Cuts nutrients and slows storm water.

rainGardens.name: 6 rain gardens
rainGardens.note: The biggest cut, at the biggest price.
